tweaks.title: Disable telemetry, tracking & targeted ads
tweaks.description: This setting disables telemetry, diagnostic data collection, activity history, app-launch tracking, targeted ads and more. It limits the data that is sent to Microsoft about your device and usage. If you are a Windows Insider, updates may be blocked until optional diagnostic data collection is turned back on.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable telemetry, tracking & targeted ads

tweaks.title: Disable tips, tricks & suggested content throughout Windows
tweaks.description: This setting removes many annoying distractions from Windows. This includes things like notifications, reminders and sync provider ads. It also prevents automated installation of suggested apps.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable tips, tricks & suggested content throughout Windows

tweaks.title: Disable Windows system and app notifications
tweaks.description: Disables native Windows system and app notifications, this includes notifications from apps like Discord, WhatsApp, Teams, and Slack.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Windows notifications and reminders

tweaks.title: Disable Windows location services & app location access
tweaks.description: This will turn off Windows Location Services and deny apps access to your location. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Windows location services & app location access

tweaks.title: Disable Find My Device location tracking
tweaks.description: This will turn off the 'Find My Device' feature, which periodically sends your device's location to Microsoft. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Find My Device location tracking

tweaks.title: Disable tips & tricks on the lock screen
tweaks.description: This will turn off the lockscreen spotlight option and disable the tips, tricks and fun facts that appear on the lock screen.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable tips & tricks on the lock screen

tweaks.title: Enable Windows spotlight desktop background and shortcut
tweaks.description: Restores the Windows spotlight desktop background and the 'Learn about this picture' shortcut.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows spotlight desktop background
tweaks.description: Turns off Windows spotlight for the desktop background, which displays rotating images and may show tips and fun facts. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Windows spotlight desktop background

tweaks.title: Hide the 'Learn about this picture' desktop shortcut
tweaks.description: Hides the 'Learn about this picture' desktop shortcut while keeping Windows spotlight wallpaper rotation enabled. It does not disable Windows spotlight.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show the 'Learn about this picture' desktop shortcut

tweaks.title: Disable ads, suggestions and newsfeed in Edge
tweaks.description: This will turn off various distractions from Microsoft Edge such as ads, suggestions and the MSN news feed. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable ads, suggestions and newsfeed in Edge

tweaks.title: Disable Microsoft Copilot
tweaks.description: This will disable and uninstall Microsoft Copilot, Windows' built-in AI assistant.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Microsoft Copilot

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Recall
tweaks.description: This will disable Windows Recall, an AI-powered feature that provides quick access to recently used files, apps and activities. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Windows Recall

tweaks.title: Disable Click To Do, AI text & image analysis
tweaks.description: This will disable Click To Do, which provides AI-powered text and image analysis features in Windows. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Click To Do, AI text & image analysis

tweaks.title: Prevent AI service from starting automatically
tweaks.description: This will set the WSAIFabricSvc service to manual startup, preventing the service from starting automatically with Windows.
tweaks.undoTitle: Allow AI service to start automatically

tweaks.title: Disable Xbox game/screen recording
tweaks.description: This will disable the Xbox game/screen recording features included with the Game Bar app. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Xbox game/screen recording

tweaks.title: Hide recommended section in the start menu
tweaks.description: This will hide the recommended section in the start menu, which shows recently added apps, recently opened files and app recommendations. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show recommended section in the start menu

tweaks.title: Hide 'All Apps' section in the start menu
tweaks.description: This will hide the 'All Apps' section in the start menu, which shows all installed apps. WARNING: Hiding this section may make it harder to find installed apps on your system. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show 'All Apps' section in the start menu

tweaks.title: Disable Phone Link integration in the start menu
tweaks.description: This will remove the Phone Link integration in the start menu when you have a mobile device linked to your PC.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Phone Link integration in the start menu

tweaks.title: Disable Bing web search & Copilot integration in search
tweaks.description: This will turn off Bing web search results and Copilot integration in the Windows search experience. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Bing web search & Copilot integration in search

tweaks.title: Hide Microsoft 365 Copilot ads in Settings Home
tweaks.description: This will turn off the Microsoft 365 Copilot ads that appear in the Settings Home page.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show Microsoft 365 Copilot ads in Settings Home

tweaks.title: Hide Settings 'Home' page
tweaks.description: Removes the 'Home' page from the Settings app.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show Settings 'Home' page

tweaks.title: Disable AI features in Microsoft Edge
tweaks.description: This will turn off AI features in Microsoft Edge, such as the AI-powered sidebar and Copilot features. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable AI features in Microsoft Edge

tweaks.title: Disable AI features in Google Chrome
tweaks.description: Disables Google Chrome's built-in AI tools and integrations, including Gemini, AI search & suggestions, writing assistance, autofill and more. It also removes local AI models. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable AI features in Google Chrome

tweaks.title: Disable AI features in Paint
tweaks.description: This will turn off AI features in Paint, such as the AI-powered image generation and editing tools. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable AI features in Paint

tweaks.title: Disable AI features in Notepad
tweaks.description: This will turn off AI features in Notepad, such as the AI-powered writing suggestions. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable AI features in Notepad

tweaks.title: Enable dark theme for system and apps
tweaks.description: This will set the app and system theme to dark mode.
tweaks.undoTitle: Disable dark theme for system and apps

tweaks.title: Use classic Windows 10 context menu style
tweaks.description: This will restore the classic Windows 10 style context menu, which is normally hidden behind the 'Show more options' entry in the new Windows 11 context menu.
tweaks.undoTitle: Use Windows 11 context menu style

tweaks.title: Disable Enhance Pointer Precision (mouse acceleration)
tweaks.description: This will disable mouse acceleration which is enabled by default in Windows. This makes mouse movement more consistent and predictable.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Enhance Pointer Precision (mouse acceleration)

tweaks.title: Disable Sticky Keys keyboard shortcut (5x shift)
tweaks.description: This will prevent the Sticky Keys dialog from appearing when you press the Shift key 5 times in a row.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Sticky Keys keyboard shortcut (5x shift)

tweaks.title: Disable window snapping
tweaks.description: This will turn off the ability to snap windows to the sides or corners of the screen.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable window snapping

tweaks.title: Disable showing app suggestions when snapping windows
tweaks.description: This will turn off app suggestions when you snap windows to the sides or corners of the screen.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable showing app suggestions when snapping windows

tweaks.title: Hide snap layout flyout at top of screen and on maximize button
tweaks.description: This will turn off the snap layout flyout that appears when you hover over the maximize button or drag windows to the top of the screen.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show snap layout flyout at top of screen and on maximize button

tweaks.title: Hide tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
Show 3 tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
Show 5 tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
Show 20 tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
Align taskbar to the left
tweaks.description: By default, Windows 11 has the taskbar buttons centered. Enabling this setting will move the taskbar buttons to the left, similar to previous versions of Windows.
tweaks.undoTitle: Align taskbar to the center

tweaks.title: Hide search icon from the taskbar
tweaks.undoTitle: Show search box on the taskbar

tweaks.title: Show search icon on the taskbar
tweaks.undoTitle: Show search box on the taskbar

tweaks.title: Show search icon with label on the taskbar
tweaks.undoTitle: Show search box on the taskbar

tweaks.title: Show search box on the taskbar
Hide 'Task view' button on the taskbar
tweaks.description: This will disable the 'Task view' button on the taskbar, which allows you to see all your open windows and virtual desktops.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show 'Task view' button on the taskbar

tweaks.title: Hide Chat (meet now) icon on the taskbar
tweaks.description: This will disable the Chat (meet now) icon on the taskbar.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show Chat (meet now) icon on the taskbar

tweaks.title: Disable Storage Sense automatic disk cleanup
tweaks.description: This will disable Storage Sense, which automatically frees up disk space by deleting temporary files, emptying the recycle bin and cleaning up files in the Downloads folder.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Storage Sense automatic disk cleanup

tweaks.title: Disable fast start-up
tweaks.description: Fast Start-up helps your PC start faster after shutdown by saving a system image to disk. Disabling Fast Start-up can help with certain issues, but may result in slightly longer boot times.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable fast start-up

tweaks.title: Disable BitLocker automatic device encryption
tweaks.description: For devices that support it, Windows 11 automatically enables BitLocker device encryption. Disabling this will turn off automatic encryption of the device, but you can still manually enable BitLocker encryption if desired. Drives that are already encrypted with BitLocker will remain encrypted when this setting is applied.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable BitLocker automatic device encryption

tweaks.title: Disable Modern Standby network connectivity
tweaks.description: By default, devices that support Modern Standby maintain network connectivity while in sleep mode. Disabling network connectivity during Modern Standby can help save battery life.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Modern Standby network connectivity

tweaks.title: Show 'End Task' option in taskbar context menu
tweaks.description: When enabled, adds an 'End Task' option to the right-click context menu for apps in the taskbar, allowing you to quickly force close apps.
tweaks.undoTitle: Hide 'End Task' option in taskbar context menu

tweaks.title: Enable 'Last Active Click' behavior for taskbar apps
tweaks.description: When enabled, clicking on an app in the taskbar will switch to the last active window of that app, instead of only showing the thumbnail preview.
tweaks.undoTitle: Disable 'Last Active Click' behavior for taskbar apps

tweaks.title: Always combine taskbar buttons and hide labels for the main display
Always combine taskbar buttons and hide labels for secondary displays
Combine taskbar buttons and hide labels when taskbar is full for the main display
tweaks.undoTitle: Always combine taskbar buttons and hide labels for the main display

tweaks.title: Combine taskbar buttons and hide labels when taskbar is full for secondary displays
tweaks.undoTitle: Always combine taskbar buttons and hide labels for secondary displays

tweaks.title: Never combine taskbar buttons and show labels for the main display
tweaks.undoTitle: Always combine taskbar buttons and hide labels for the main display

tweaks.title: Never combine taskbar buttons and show labels for secondary displays
tweaks.undoTitle: Always combine taskbar buttons and hide labels for secondary displays

tweaks.title: Show app icons on all taskbars
Show app icons on main taskbar and on taskbar where the window is open
tweaks.undoTitle: Show app icons on all taskbars

tweaks.title: Show app icons only on taskbar where the window is open
tweaks.undoTitle: Show app icons on all taskbars

tweaks.title: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'Home'
Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'This PC'
tweaks.undoTitle: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'Home'

tweaks.title: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'Downloads'
tweaks.undoTitle: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'Home'

tweaks.title: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'OneDrive'
tweaks.undoTitle: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'Home'

tweaks.title: Show file extensions for known file types
tweaks.description: This will show file extensions for known file types. By default, Windows hides file extensions for known file types which can lead to confusion and security risks.
tweaks.undoTitle: Hide file extensions for known file types

tweaks.title: Show hidden files, folders and drives
tweaks.description: By default, Windows hides certain files, folders and drives to prevent accidental modification or deletion. Turn this on to show all files in File Explorer.
tweaks.undoTitle: Hide hidden files, folders and drives

tweaks.title: Hide 'Home' from navigation pane
tweaks.description: Hides the 'Home' section from the File Explorer navigation pane. Warning: This may prevent Quick access links from updating until you restart your PC or Windows Explorer.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show 'Home' in navigation pane

tweaks.title: Hide 'Gallery' from navigation pane
tweaks.description: Hides the 'Gallery' section from the File Explorer navigation pane.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show 'Gallery' in navigation pane

tweaks.title: Disable transparency effects
tweaks.description: This will disable transparency effects on Windows and interfaces. Which can help improve performance on older hardware.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable transparency effects

tweaks.title: Disable animations and visual effects
tweaks.description: This will disable animations and some visual effects in Windows, which can make the interface feel snappier, especially on older hardware.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable animations and visual effects

tweaks.title: Prevent getting updates as soon as they're available
tweaks.description: This will prevent your PC from being among the first to receive new non-security updates. Your PC will still receive these updates eventually.
tweaks.undoTitle: Allow getting updates as soon as they're available

tweaks.title: Prevent automatic restarts after updates while signed in
tweaks.description: This will prevent your PC from automatically restarting after updates while any user is signed in.
tweaks.undoTitle: Allow automatic restarts after updates while signed in

tweaks.title: Disable driver updates through Windows Update
tweaks.description: Prevents Windows from automatically downloading and installing driver updates via regular Windows quality updates. Windows can still automatically install drivers for new devices. Drivers included in security, critical, or feature updates may still be installed.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable driver updates through Windows Update

tweaks.title: Prevent Windows from auto-installing device companion apps
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from silently installing device companion apps via Windows Update when you connect certain devices, like monitors from LG and Alienware. These devices will still work as expected, this only stops Windows Update from automatically installing additional apps without consent.
tweaks.undoTitle: Allow automatic installation of device companion apps

tweaks.title: Hide 'OneDrive' from navigation pane
tweaks.description: Hides the 'OneDrive' section from the File Explorer navigation pane.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show 'OneDrive' in navigation pane

tweaks.title: Add common folders back to 'This PC' page
tweaks.description: This setting will add common folders like Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures and Videos back to the 'This PC' page in File Explorer.
tweaks.undoTitle: Remove common folders from 'This PC' page

tweaks.title: Disable bloat in Brave browser (AI, Crypto, etc.)
tweaks.description: This will disable Brave's built-in AI features, Crypto wallet, News, Rewards, Talk and VPN. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
tweaks.undoTitle: Enable Brave browser features (AI, Crypto, etc.)

tweaks.title: Show drive letters before drive label
tweaks.description: This setting will show drive letters before the drive label in File Explorer.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show drive letters after drive label

tweaks.title: Show drive letters after drive label
tweaks.description: This setting will show drive letters after the drive label in File Explorer (Default Windows behavior).

tweaks.title: Show network drive letters before drive label
tweaks.description: This setting will show only network drive letters before the drive label in File Explorer.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show drive letters after drive label

tweaks.title: Hide all drive letters
tweaks.description: This setting will hide all drive letters from the File Explorer navigation pane and 'This PC'.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show drive letters after drive label

tweaks.title: Show All Apps in Category view (Default)
tweaks.description: This will set the All Apps section in the start menu to show apps grouped by category.

tweaks.title: Show All Apps in Grid view
tweaks.description: This will set the All Apps section in the start menu to show apps in an alphabetical grid layout.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show All Apps in Category view

tweaks.title: Show All Apps in List view
tweaks.description: This will set the All Apps section in the start menu to show apps in an alphabetical list layout.
tweaks.undoTitle: Show All Apps in Category view

groups.title: Combine taskbar buttons on the main display
groups.description: This setting allows you to choose how taskbar buttons are combined on the main display.

groups.title: Start menu 'All Apps' view
groups.description: This setting allows you to change the layout of the 'All Apps' section in the start menu, or hide it entirely. Hiding this section may make it harder to find installed apps on your system. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

groups.title: Combine taskbar buttons on secondary displays
groups.description: This setting allows you to choose how taskbar buttons are combined on secondary displays.

groups.title: Show taskbar apps on
groups.description: This setting allows you to choose where taskbar app buttons are shown when using multiple monitors.

options.label: Main taskbar and taskbar where window is open

groups.title: Open File Explorer to
groups.description: This setting allows you to choose the default location that File Explorer opens to.

groups.title: Taskbar search style
groups.description: This setting allows you to customize the appearance of the search box on the taskbar.

groups.title: Windows spotlight on the desktop
groups.description: This setting controls the Windows spotlight desktop background option. Keep the rotating wallpaper with or without the 'Learn about this picture' shortcut, or disable Windows spotlight entirely.

groups.title: Show tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
groups.description: This setting allows you to choose whether to show tabs from apps (such as Edge browser tabs) when snapping windows or pressing Alt+Tab.

groups.title: Drive letter position
groups.description: This setting allows you to choose where drive letters are shown in File Explorer.
